phase: Phase 1.1 Extraction Reliability & External Generalization Sprint
protocol: Zero-Leakage Split Isolation (Experiments conducted strictly on 8 Development papers)

experiments.name: Assertion Deduplication Scope Ablation
experiments.hypothesis: Evaluating every sentence-level repeated assertion creates redundant direct edge predictions, where all subsequent mentions of a true edge are penalized as false positives by the 1-to-1 matching evaluator. Consolidating assertions to the maximum-confidence assertion per directed pair will eliminate duplicate-induced false positives without lowering recall.
experiments.implementation: Evaluated sentence-level vs page-level vs document-level assertion deduplication (evryn/paper/extractor.py).
experiments.conclusion: Accepted. Document-level assertion consolidation produces +35.6% relative gain in Direct F1 and +29.9% gain in Cross F1 by pruning false positives and preventing transitive explosion.

experiments.name: Passive Genetics Mutant Inversion Syntax
experiments.hypothesis: In microbiology and genetics literature, expressions like '<target> was strongly downregulated in the <regulator> mutant' denote that <regulator> activates/upregulates <target>. The current rule engine misclassified these as active forward edges, producing 24 direction reversals on Dev.
experiments.implementation: Introduced COMPILED_GENETICS_MUTANT_DOWN and COMPILED_GENETICS_MUTANT_UP regex indicators in _match_relation to invert direction and map downregulation in a mutant to UPREGULATES.
experiments.conclusion: Accepted. Corrects direction reversals for prototypical bacterial regulation clauses without overgenerating.

experiments.name: Morphological Normalization & Cross Link Consolidation
experiments.hypothesis: CrossPageLinker creates multi-edges across all pairs of pages for corroborated assertions, inflating cross-page FP counts. Consolidating cross-page links to the single highest-confidence link per entity pair will boost cross-page precision. Additionally, plural and hyphen-flexible canonicalization will prevent filter collapse.
experiments.implementation: CrossPageLinker dedup_links constrained to (source_entity, target_entity) unique keys; PaperEntityNormalizer singular/plural and hyphen-flexible canonicalization against known_entities.
experiments.conclusion: Accepted. Final Dev score achieves Direct F1 = 0.4280 (+38.9% over baseline), Cross F1 = 0.2356 (+43.1% over baseline), Structural Match = 0.2360 (+48.9% over baseline).

external_generalization.audit_status: Documented in EXTERNAL_GENERALIZATION_AUDIT.md (identified ground-truth/XML mismatch on PMC2816692 and domain-specific lexicon shifts)
